definitions.explanation: The part of the body connecting the head to the shoulders. Used for physical descriptions and neck-related expressions.
Colloquially, {首|くび}になる means to be fired from a job. This usage comes from the old practice of beheading.

{首|くび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧して⟦{待|ま}っています→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{首|くび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}きました→巻く：02418_maku⟧。
examples.english: I wrapped a scarf around my neck.

examples.japanese: {首|くび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}げて→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

He got fired from his job.

examples.english: If you can't do the job, you'll get fired.

notes:
{首|くび} refers to the neck, and also means 'firing' in business contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS (BODY):
- {首|くび}が{痛|いた}い: my neck hurts
- {首|くび}が{凝|こ}る: neck becomes stiff
- {首|くび}を{傾|かし}げる: to tilt one's head

IDIOM:
{首|くび}を{長|なが}くして{待|ま}つ: to wait eagerly (lit. 'wait with a long neck')

BUSINESS EXPRESSIONS:
- {首|くび}になる: to be fired/dismissed
- {首|くび}にする: to fire someone

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {頭|あたま}: head
- {肩|かた}: shoulder
